title: Zymo-Seq RiboFree Total RNA Library Prep P5 Adapter Ligation
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol performs P5 Adapter Ligation for the [Zymo-Seq RiboFree™ Total RNA Library Prep](https://files.zymoresearch.com/protocols/r3000_zymo-seq_ribofree_total_rna_library_kit.pdf). This protocol is meant to be run on one OT-2 in conjunction with a second OT-2 running solely Select-a-Size MagBead Clean-up Protocol. Samples will be processed down columns and then across rows (A1, B1, C1, ... A2, B2, etc.). Thoroughly mix reagent tubes thoroughly by flicking or pipetting before starting. Briefly spin down and load onto the temperature module according to `Setup` below. The user is prompted to replace tipracks mid-protocol when necessary (for > 76 samples). steps.title: Prepare reagents and load module
steps.instruction: Gather all required hardware and reagents for the P5 Adapter Ligation run on one OT‑2 (with a second OT‑2 for Select‑a‑Size MagBead Clean‑up) and place the temperature module on the deck.

substeps.instruction: Opentrons Thermocycler Module with NEST 96‑well PCR plate (full skirt)
Opentrons Temperature Module GEN2 with 4 × 6 aluminum block for NEST 1.5 ml screw‑cap reagent tubes

steps.title: Mix reagent tubes thoroughly
steps.instruction: Flick or pipette each reagent tube to ensure complete mixing before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Spin down and load onto temperature module
steps.instruction: Briefly spin down all reagent tubes and load them onto the temperature module according to the Setup instructions.

steps.title: Enter sample count and mount sides
steps.instruction: Input the number of samples to process and specify the mount sides for the P20 GEN2 single‑channel and P50 GEN1 multi‑channel pipettes in the OT‑2 software.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the P5 Adapter Ligation protocol file from the Zymo‑Seq RiboFree documentation.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck layout exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing all labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the labware, tiprack, and the selected pipettes (P20 GEN2 single‑channel and P50 GEN1 multi‑channel). Refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the P5 Adapter Ligation workflow. The system will prompt tip‑rack replacement when processing more than 76 samples.
